([[2024–25 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|2025]]) }} '''Trey Kaufman-Renn''' (born August 19, 2002) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball|Purdue Boilermakers]] of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. == High school career == Kaufman-Renn attended [[Silver Creek High School (Indiana)|Silver Creek High School]] in [[Sellersburg, Indiana]].{{Cite web |date=2024-04-05 |title=Southern Indiana will be cheering for Trey-Kaufman Renn during Final Four |url=https://www.whas11.com/article/sports/basketball/southern-indiana-purdue-forward-final-four-trey-kaufman-renn-silver-creek-high-school/417-9db57273-30bf-47b7-af4e-0e392c6cae3e |access-date=2024-04-09 |website=whas11.com }}{{Cite web |last=Neddenriep |first=Kyle |title=All eyes on Silver Creek's Trey Kaufman |url=https://www.heraldtimesonline.com/story/sports/high-school/2020/02/03/all-eyes-on-silver-creeks-trey-kaufman/116041806/ |access-date=2024-04-09 |website=The Herald-Times }} During his time at Silver Creek, he became the school's all-time leading scorer.{{Cite web |last=Kim |first=David J. |title=Trey Kaufman-Renn becomes Silver Creek basketball's all-time scoring leader |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/preps/indiana/2021/01/17/purdue-trey-kaufman-renn-becomes-silver-creek-basketball-scoring-leader/4195561001/ |access-date=2024-04-09 |website=The Courier-Journal }} During his junior season, he averaged 25.8 points, 9.6 rebounds, and 1.6 blocks per game.{{Cite web |last=Tachman |first=Tyler |date=2020-08-18 |title=Meet high school renaissance man Trey Kaufman |url=https://www.insidethehall.com/2020/08/18/meet-high-school-renaissance-man-trey-kaufman/ |access-date=2024-04-09 |website=Inside the Hall }} As a senior, Kaufman-Renn helped lead Silver Creek to state championship.{{Cite web |last=Kim |first=David J. |title=Trey Kaufman-Renn, Kooper Jacobi end Silver Creek careers with IHSAA Class 3A state title |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/story/sports/preps/indiana/2021/04/03/ihsaa-boys-basketball-class-3-a-state-final-silver-creek-defeats-leo/6996512002/ |access-date=2024-04-09 |website=The Courier-Journal }} He finished the season averaging 24.5 points, 11.8 rebounds, 3.6 assists and 1.9 blocks per game.{{Cite web |last=Cook |first=Josh |date=2021-06-24 |title=NTSPY BOYS' BASKETBALL FINALIST: Trey Kaufman-Renn |url=https://www.newsandtribune.com/sports/ntspy-boys-basketball-finalist-trey-kaufman-renn/article_ac131d5e-d4ad-11eb-976b-9f5f3e52e516.html |access-date=2024-04-09 She played basketball in high-school, where she wore the same number Kaufman-Renn wears today. Trey has a younger brother named Jaylen.{{Cite web |last=Stone |first=Matt |title=Silver Creek star, Purdue commit Trey Kaufman-Renn's has special bond with his mom |url=https://www.courier-journal.com/picture-gallery/sports/preps/indiana/2021/02/22/purdue-commit-trey-kaufman-renns-unbreakable-trust-with-his-mom/4533232001/ |access-date=2024-12-31 |website=The Courier-Journal |language=en-US}} His uncle, Matt Renn, was a 4-year star at [[Indiana_State_Sycamores_men%27s_basketball|Indiana State]].
